system_thesis: 在严格保留 Tongji University / 同济大学、同济大学设计创意学院与 iDVX Lab 既有公开识别的前提下，建立一套面向校园传播与访客展示的年轻创意型周边延展系统。系统以实验室公开标识为核心，通过学院式克制排版、数据可视化启发的模块纹样与校园语境图层，传达“研究、秩序、活力、开放”的感受；所有权威感锚点均来自公开官方来源，不以推断色彩或替代性 logo 取代既有身份。

derived_from.notes: Derived new from public official assets because no bundled reference exists for Tongji IDVX Lab.

tokens.name: tongji-blue
tokens.usage: Primary institutional anchor for headings, logo lockup support, tote/cover accent bands, and disciplined data-line emphasis.

tokens.name: deep-ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and linework color for high legibility on light merch surfaces.

tokens.name: paper-white
tokens.usage: Warm off-white ground for tote canvas, notebook cover field, and gallery swatches.

tokens.name: steel-grid
tokens.usage: Secondary gridlines, campus outline strokes, and subdued information layers.

tokens.name: signal-coral
tokens.usage: Small youthful accent for badge edge details, section markers, and callout dots only.

tokens.name: campus-green
tokens.usage: Optional support tone derived from campus environment for secondary merchandise variants and scene grounding.

display.use: Large merchandise hero titling and campaign headings with calm academic confidence.

headline.use: Primary product naming and bilingual item labels.

subhead.use: Supporting descriptors such as material, series, and edition notes.

body.use: Short explanatory lines baked into posters and gallery notes.

caption.use: Small annotations, product specs, and institutional attribution.

mono.use: Data tags, coordinates, edition numbers, and modular pattern labels.

grid.principle: Editorial modular grid with strong margins and repeatable placement zones for official marks and auxiliary patterning.

motif_system.name: Campus Data Grid
motif_system.description: A restrained auxiliary language built from modular grid cells, campus path-like lines, dotted data nodes kept sparse, and architectural contour fragments. Use as background field, stitch-like repeat, or edge band; never let it overpower the official iDVX logo.

do_say: 同济大学设计创意学院 iDVX Lab 周边系列
Data, design, and campus memory in one restrained system.
智能大数据可视化实验室 / Intelligent Big Data Visualization Lab

lockup.string_en: Tongji University College of Design and Innovation | Intelligent Big Data Visualization Lab
lockup.usage: Use official organisation naming exactly as cited; pair with official-idvx-logo and, when attribution is needed, official-tjdi-logo. Do not redraw marks.

imagery_strategy.approach: For campus teachers, students, and visitors, prefer people-free or lightly inhabited official campus contexts, close product mockups, hands/material surfaces, and technical-detail compositions. Use campus photos and official logos as grounding references; extract atmosphere from research project images rather than reproducing them verbatim.

rules: Do not replace any existing official logo. official-idvx-logo, official-tjdi-logo, and official-tongji-photo-logo remain canonical marks.
Use the official organisation name exactly as cited in research/evidence.json and mirrored in lockup strings.
Prefer image_edit whenever a relevant reference asset is marked allowed_for_edit=true.
Do not synthesize a competing version of any asset with do_not_replace=true.
Project screenshots may inspire abstraction but must not be copied as finished merch artwork.

do_not_use: MIT Media Lab style variable logo
